title: Consumer reports an unauthorized electronic transfer or scam

governance.access_policy: Public-source competitive intelligence; legal review before external sharing

moments.title: Customer notices an unauthorized item or realises a scam; Citi Fraud…
moments.customer_action: Customer notices an unauthorized item or realises a scam; Citi Fraud and Scam Prevention Central 'Take control after a scam': cease contact, call the number on the card/statement, file with local law enforcement, FTC (reportfraud.ftc.gov) and IC3; safety tips: Citi never asks for password/OTP, never texts from a 10-digit number, warns against 'transfer money to yourself' requests

touchpoints.screen: Phone: number on back of card / 1-888-CITIBANK (ATM-Debit disputes 1-888-248-4226, TTY 1-800-945-0258) or post-login Contact Us > Chat; no self-service deposit-account dispute form (credit cards have Account Details > Dispute Charge > Dispute Center)

moments.title: Citi investigates within 10 Business Days (20 for new accounts) or…
moments.action: Citi investigates within 10 Business Days (20 for new accounts) or provisionally credits and extends to 45/90 days

moments.title: Outcome communicated; liability $50 if reported within 2 Business Days,…
moments.action: Outcome communicated; liability $50 if reported within 2 Business Days, up to $500 otherwise (CA/NY exceptions); Zero Liability for debit card with reasonable care

moments.title: Citi Quick Lock (Citi Mobile App or Citi Online) blocks new…
moments.customer_action: Citi Quick Lock (Citi Mobile App or Citi Online) blocks new purchases/ATM withdrawals while allowing recurring transactions, bill payments, deposits, credits and online transfers; PIN reset; Bank Card Replacement page

moments.title: Authorized scam payment: Zelle imposter scams may be reimbursed;…
moments.action: Authorized scam payment: Zelle imposter scams may be reimbursed; wires/other authorized transfers are not

fail_points.text: Wires excluded from reimbursement for authorized transfers; for unauthorized online wires, NY AG alleges a notarized-affidavit prerequisite, branch-visit requirement and 30-60 day form-letter denials (allegations; S.D.N.Y. denied MTD on EFTA claims Jan 2025; appeal pending).

touchpoints.screen: Citi Mobile App help / CitiPhone Banking

moments.frontstage: Contact center authenticates and opens a claim or investigation; written follow-up may be required within 10 Business Days for phone claims

fail_points.text: No evidence of an in-app virtual assistant handling money-movement disputes; phone remains the escalation path.

status_tracking.where: Dispute status tracking exists for credit cards in-app; not evidenced for deposit EFT claims

exceptions.trigger: Citi suspects the customer is a scam victim or activity is suspicious
exceptions.customer_experience: Citi may refuse, block, delay or return withdrawals, payments or transfers (including incoming credits with mismatched information) and hold funds pending investigation (Restricted Access terms effective April 1, 2026)
exceptions.bank_handling: Risk review; customer contacted via Citi-owned channels
exceptions.resolution: Phone/Chat verification; funds released or returned

assessment: Reg E procedures standard; no self-service deposit-dispute tracker evidenced.
